title: Conditional κ = 0.001677641731343354: classical matrix boundary with signed554 T74
body:
This specializes PR1673's faster matrix-boundary transfer using the established Le Gall 2014 bound, giving conditional **κ = 0.001677641731343354** (`838820865671677/500000000000000000`). It exceeds PR1688's reported 0.001677255458915620663570888508.

The general stability lemma in PR1673 requires only `omega_C < tau`. Le Gall's published `omega_C < 2.3728639` permits the fixed target `tau=12/5`; the resulting boundary saving `3/10+xi-epsilon` is nonbinding. The faster union layout and all of its costs stay as proved in PR1673. Thus this specialization does not need the additional Nine Fourths preprint premise. The fixed algebraic-formula, absolute-precision, sequential-tape and per-bit normalization arguments are written out in `CLASSICAL-MATRIX-TRANSFER.md`. [Published matrix theorem](https://arxiv.org/html/1401.7714v1).

The supplier is an independently reconstructed signed-554 extension of PR1625 with PR1319's T74 geometry: 319680 whole-helper roles, 249 base / 417 extra calls, live width 66304, prefix 1441 charged at 2048, row coefficient 19545 below 20161. PR1672 published the same local kernel profile first and receives that credit; PR1673 supplies the outer construction and general matrix lemma. PR1681/1683/1688 are prior compositions. Exact source pins and all original notices are retained.

Validation:

- Both new native words, independent 704-column maps, wrappers/phases, strict T74 admission, exact moments and geometry controls passed in the prototype. A complete fresh portable macOS replay of the same finite supplier and the earlier Strassen specialization also passed.
- The new exact ledger has 47 positive inequalities and six rejecting controls. A separate exact elimination reconstructs all nine paid cost powers. Literal recipe checks reject 16 broken edits.
- Final-package fresh read-only-source replays passed all 18 stages on macOS/Python 3.11 (523.47 s) and Linux/Python 3.14 (624.99 s). The complete `MATH.json` receipts are byte-identical: SHA256 `9a2cacbdc7e19e339a927ac0e70b8ee8d490835304ebae89e24aaf2243e3a7a5`. Manifest SHA256 `ca065106f85a58250696278f07dc9f9405b1c240986b0e103da76537e3b7b272`. All 399 committed package files match the frozen source bytes. [Dedicated hosted CI](https://github.com/chafreaky/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/38527810806) passed on Python 3.11 and 3.14 at head `9f0c00d353b521c6840729861e48d7d0da20d345`. Both hosted complete mathematical receipts are byte-identical to both cold-platform receipts. Upstream PR checks remain queued and are separate from this completed fork CI.

The default verifier always replays the parent and both new native words, reconstructs owners, validates strict admission and geometry, replays the original outer evidence, then checks the new composition. It has no native-reuse flags:

```sh
python3 -m pip install -r research/t74-signed554-phase-fusion/requirements.txt
CXX=c++ BOOST_INCLUDE=/path/to/boost/include python3 -B \
  research/t74-signed554-phase-fusion/verify.py --work /absolute/new-work
```

The multiplication bound remains conditional on the inherited all-size compiler, common-label/mutable-source, hosting, precision C1=1, fixed-tape/prime-packing, equal-chunk interchange, exact-recovery and analytic hypotheses. The published matrix theorem and the written outer proof are mathematical inputs, not consequences of finite checks. No practical finite matrix scheme, runtime speedup, unconditional multiplication theorem or independent human review is claimed. The selected-result record is unchanged.

Prepared by Chafik Boukhalfa with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. New material is Apache-2.0; predecessor attribution remains intact.
